data.title: Grundsteuerwert increased to €184,300 (Wertfortschreibung)
data.summary: The Finanzamt Musterweilburg (Bewertungsstelle Grundbesitz) has updated the Grundsteuerwert (property tax value) of the house at Ackerstraße 26 to €184,300 as of 1 January 2026, because a 38 m² extension was added to the building in 2025. A separate Grundsteuermessbescheid and the municipality's own Grundsteuer assessment will follow based on this value.
data.explanation: This is a tax office notice (Bescheid) that only resets the official value of your house for property tax purposes; it does not itself demand any payment. If you think the new value is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt Musterweilburg — the app will show you the deadline, which runs from when the letter is legally considered delivered. You can file it in writing, electronically, or in person (zur Niederschrift). If you take no action, the new value becomes final and will be used for the next Grundsteuer assessments.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch) against the Grundsteuerwert
items.action: Review the new Grundsteuerwert and, if you disagree, file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt Musterweilburg in writing, electronically or in person by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the Grundsteuerwert of €184,300 becomes final and binding for future Grundsteuer assessments.
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch beim Finanzamt Musterweilburg eingelegt werden, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
